context: Tests whether the agent correctly identifies a complex multi-system feature as requiring Deep depth, produces all three required planning artifacts (spec.md, design.md, tasks.md), and formats design.md with the correct template sections. Scenario-0 covers Standard spec.md creation and scenario-1 covers tasks.md — this scenario focuses on the Deep depth path and the design.md artifact.

checklist.name: 4-digit zero-padded dir
checklist.description: The spec directory is named with a 4-digit zero-padded number prefix (e.g. `specs/0001-*/`) — NOT `specs/1-*` or `specs/real-time-*/`

checklist.name: spec.md depth field is Deep
checklist.description: spec.md frontmatter contains `depth: Deep` (exactly 'Deep', not 'Standard' or 'deep')

checklist.name: design.md created
checklist.description: A `design.md` file exists inside the numbered spec directory

checklist.name: design.md Architecture section
checklist.description: design.md contains a `## Architecture` section with content

checklist.name: design.md Decisions section
checklist.description: design.md contains a `## Decisions` section with content (trade-offs and rationale)

checklist.name: design.md Dependencies section
checklist.description: design.md contains a `## Dependencies` section with content

checklist.name: tasks.md also created
checklist.description: A `tasks.md` file exists inside the numbered spec directory alongside spec.md and design.md

checklist.name: spec.md status Draft
checklist.description: spec.md frontmatter `status` field is set to `Draft`

checklist.name: spec.md Story section
checklist.description: spec.md contains a `## Story` section with 'As a ..., I want ..., so that ...' content

checklist.name: _current pointer written
checklist.description: `specs/_current` exists and contains the name of the newly created spec directory

checklist.name: No implementation code
checklist.description: No source code files (.js, .ts, .py, etc.) are created outside of `specs/` — only planning artifacts
